thread:
anne_pm: Quick sync — customer asks keep coming for finer-grained retention tiers and clearer BYOK handshake SLAs. Can we run a quick prioritization and decide minimum launch scope?

mike_eng: +1. We should avoid full keystore UI for MVP. Suggest 3 retention buckets (30d, 1y, 7y) + export for legal hold.

jordan_security: From security side we need KMS integration (BYOK) + key rotation docs. Can we commit to HSM-backed KMS for enterprise only?

sarah_legal: Customers asking for e-discovery support. Export format must include chain-of-custody metadata (who/when/access). Prefer JSONL + signed manifest.

anne_pm: Proposal: MVP = audit streaming + 3 retention tiers + export ZIP with signed manifest. BYOK gated to Dedicated/Private in first launch. QA: does that satisfy SOC2 evidence requirements for pilots?

mike_eng: Technically doable. Tradeoffs: BYOK in MVP adds ~3 sprints (key rotation, escrow, attestation, e2e tests). If gated to Dedicated/Private we keep hosted GA on schedule.

luis_sre: Operational ask: need retention TTL enforcement, cold-archive lifecycle hook, and indexing for search SLA. Indexing costs are big — propose delayed indexing for >1y bucket.

jordan_security: Also require audit immutability guarantees (append-only logs + merkle proof) for customers requesting long-term compliance. Can be phased: append-only v1, merkle proofs v2.

anne_pm: Ok actions: 1) Ship retention buckets + export manifest in hosted GA. 2) BYOK+HSM = Dedicated/Private launch. 3) Add merkle proof and attestation in roadmap Q2 post-GA.

sarah_legal: Add acceptance criteria: export includes signed manifest, per-tenant access logs, and retention policy UI shows effective TTL and legal-hold override.

mike_eng: Dev tasks sketched: retention-service (TTL enforcement), export pipeline (zip + manifest signer), indexing toggle, keystore handshake stub for Dedicated. I can scope stories.

anne_pm: Cool. @mike_eng please post a rough story estimate by EOD. @jordan_security can you draft the minimal security spec for BYOK gating? @sarah_legal will produce the export manifest schema.

jordan_security: Will do, aiming for a 1-pager covering threat model + attestation requirements.

ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: retention-service branch created by mike_eng at <https://git.internal/r/redwood/retention-service/pull/42> :rocket:

luis_sre: Quick note — alerting: add SLO burn alerts for export failures and retention lag > 15m.

anne_pm: Thanks all. I'll capture decisions in the roadmap doc and update the compliance epic. Short follow-up in #product once estimates are in. :thumbsup:
